title: French Open / Roland Garros
metaDescription: Roland-Garros, also called the French Open, is the clay-court Grand Slam played at Stade Roland-Garros in Paris

overview.about: Roland-Garros — the French Open — is the clay-court Grand Slam, the slowest and most physically punishing of the four majors, played each late spring in western Paris. First contested in 1891, its red terre battue rewards patience and topspin over raw power. No record in tennis is more untouchable than Rafael Nadal's fourteen titles here; Chris Evert's seven is the women's mark. The 2027 tournament runs 23 May – 6 June.
overview.nextEvent: The 2027 Roland-Garros runs 23 May – 6 June at Stade Roland-Garros, the middle major of the year and the only one on clay. Centre-court matches on Court Philippe-Chatrier now play under a retractable roof, but the outside courts stay at the mercy of Paris spring weather.
